against: S3 could reach the first-Tab regression because it worked before the change and no software configuration option restores it.
rule_gap: S3’s “fails in a supported setup” does not clearly cover a first-Tab miss in a self-written wrapper that omits the call prescribed by zsh’s manual and works on the second Tab.
reason: Under the test question, one extra Tab per new shell is acceptable to ship without surfacing: completion immediately recovers, inserts nothing wrong, and both documented installation methods work.
